fields.label: Initialize Git
fields.command_text: git init && git add . && git commit -m 'Initial commit'

fields.label: Install Tailwind CSS
fields.command_text: npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer && npx tailwindcss init -p

fields.label: Setup Python Virtual Environment
fields.command_text: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip

fields.label: Install Django Dependencies
fields.command_text: pip install django djangorestframework django-cors-headers python-decouple

fields.label: Create Django Project
fields.command_text: django-admin startproject myproject . && python manage.py startapp myapp

fields.label: Setup Database
fields.command_text: python manage.py makemigrations && python manage.py migrate

fields.label: Create Admin User
fields.command_text: echo "from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model; User = get_user_model(); User.objects.create_superuser('admin', 'admin@example.com', 'admin123')" | python manage.py shell
